BE.thesis_one_line: Makes on-site power units for AI data centers; sales are surging, but the share price already assumes roughly 30% yearly cash growth for a decade.
kill_criteria: Any single quarter's revenue below $900M or full-year 2026 revenue guidance cut below the $3.9B low end.
A top customer above 40% of quarterly revenue in the 10-Q for two consecutive quarters, or customer-deposit balance falling by more than 25% quarter on quarter.
Non-GAAP gross margin below 30% in any quarter (versus 34.3% in Q2'26).
Diluted share count rising more than 10% year on year, or any new equity-linked consideration to customers above $250M.
Trailing-twelve-month FCF below zero for two consecutive quarters while revenue is still growing.
key_adverse_facts: Two customers were about 44% and 21% of Q2'26 revenue (10-Q); one customer about 73% of H1 revenue
Price implies ~31% 10-yr FCF CAGR vs base ~19%; 58.6x FY27 EPS; Street mean target $280 below $288.70 price
Oracle warrant fair value $251.6M booked as customer-consideration asset reducing future revenue; shares +4.8% in six months
Short-seller report 8 Jul 2026 on raw-material supply, rejected by company 9 Jul 2026
data_conflicts: d4 FCF $531.6M vs filing-derived TTM FCF $624.7M
d4 forward EPS $4.93 is FY27, not NTM
BE.confidence_in_thesis: low: demand and guidance are strong, but customer concentration and valuation make the result hinge on a few buyers

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF at 10% WACC implies ~31% 10-year FCF CAGR versus my ~19% base case.

BE.scenario_basis: Sep-2029 price = 2029 non-GAAP EPS x exit P/E, no dividend: bear $3.0 x 15; base $7.5 x 28; bull $11.0 x 35, from $288.70 (FY26 consensus $2.71, FY27 $4.93).

IP.thesis_one_line: Large US box and paper maker mid-turnaround; looks cheap but cash flow does not cover the dividend and profit guidance was cut twice this year.
kill_criteria: Full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance cut below $3.20B, or Q3'26 adjusted EBITDA below $780M.

Trailing-four-quarter free cash flow (OCF - capex, company definition) below $400M at the Q4'26 report while the $1.85 dividend is maintained, or a dividend cut without an offsetting rating-agency view.
Consolidated net debt (debt $9.2B less cash) / TTM adjusted EBITDA above 3.5x, or a downgrade of either agency's senior rating to below investment grade.
PS EMEA segment operating loss worse than $(80)M in any quarter after Q4'26.
EMEA spin-off not completed by 30 Apr 2027 (15 months from the 29 Jan 2026 announcement per the 10-Q '12-15 months').
key_adverse_facts: FY26 adjusted EBITDA guide cut from $3.5-3.7B (Jan) to $3.20-3.50B (Apr) to $3.20-3.40B (Jul)
H1'26 FCF $87M vs dividends paid $490M; TTM company FCF $492M
PS EMEA operating loss $(80)M in Q2'26 vs $(1)M a year ago
Moody's Baa2 negative outlook; containerboard antitrust class action filed 29 Jul 2025

d4 trailing EPS $(5.39) includes goodwill impairment and discontinued ops

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF at 8% WACC implies ~9-12% 10-year unlevered FCF CAGR versus my ~11% base case.

NCLH.thesis_one_line: Third-largest cruise line trading at about 10x earnings, but demand is soft, debt is heavy, and profit forecasts have been cut twice this year.
kill_criteria: Full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance below $2.50B, or Q3'26 adjusted EBITDA below $874M.
Q4'26 constant-currency net yield decline worse than -5%, or FY27 initial guidance of negative net yield.
Net leverage (company definition: net debt / TTM adjusted EBITDA, consolidated) above 5.5x at any quarter-end, or liquidity below $1.0B.
Eleventh Circuit remand reinstating the $112.9M Havana Docks judgment, or any new covenant waiver.
key_adverse_facts: FY26 adjusted EPS guide cut from $2.38 (Mar) to $1.45-1.79 (May) to ~$1.50 (Jul); Q3 net yield guided -8.9% cc
Net leverage 5.3x, total debt $15.0B, liquidity $1.5B; H1'26 FCF $(480)M
New CEO Feb 2026; company says it remains 'below its optimal booked position for the next 12 months'
Havana Docks: Supreme Court reversed dismissal 21 May 2026, remanded 22 Jun 2026 ($112.9M judgment previously entered)
data_conflicts: d4 trailing EPS $1.65 vs 2026 guided adjusted EPS ~$1.50
d4 FCF $(1.68)B is before export-credit financing of newbuild capex
NCLH.confidence_in_thesis: low: cheap on EPS but estimates are still falling and leverage leaves little room for error

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF implies ~3-4% 10-year owner-earnings growth versus my ~4-5% base case.
